snippet.title: Ricochet Raven - Official Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Parry, parkour and survive in Ricochet Raven out NOW!! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4002020/Ricochet_Raven/

Ricochet Raven is an indie game i have been solo developing for the past 2 years in my free time, a little roguelike game where the only way you can attack enemies is by parrying theirs's back at them! upgrade how deflected attacks respond by obtaining feather upgrades, mix and stack them to create crazy combos! the game is out in early access now! and i plan to update it with more content over time! it's honestly surreal seeing it out now after so long, and i hope you have fun with it!
